title: CareLens web session export
description: Estimates and check-in events from one browser session. Wellbeing trends only - not a medical device. No media, no device ids, no free-text device labels. Validated by web/src/export/schema.ts and carelens/websession.py (hand-written, kept in step by tests).

params_version.description: whole-number floats such as 7.0 are accepted (JSON Schema integer)

tz_offset_min.description: minutes EAST of UTC (matches the offset in started_at)

summaries.description: optional (absent in older exports): whole-measurement results, currently HRV from a fingertip measurement

truncated.description: true when a per-metric / event row cap was hit and later rows were dropped

t.description: seconds since started_at, at the END of the analysed window

value.description: bpm or breaths/min; null when the estimator withheld a value (such rows still count towards coverage)

reported.description: true when the quality gate let the value be shown

span_s.description: analysed window length; the estimate is centred at t - span_s/2

t.description: seconds since started_at when the result was produced

kind.description: hrv (W6), a W7 guided mobility test, the W8 rhythmic-hand-movement test, the W9 blink / eyes-closed summary, the W9 activity summary, or a W10 sound summary (snoring sounds, possible pauses in breathing sounds, talking time); wellbeing trends only

reason.description: ok | too_short | low_fps | unsteady | too_many_artifacts (hrv); out_of_view | not_seated_at_start | no_rise | no_turn | not_seated_at_end | incomplete | not_side_on | no_walk | too_short | bad_height (mobility); ok | no_hand | too_short | low_fps | moving | no_rhythm (hand_tremor); ok | no_face | low_fps | head_turned | calibrating (blink); ok | too_short (activity); ok (snoring, talking); ok | no_regular_breathing (pauses)

duration_s.description: hrv: length of the continuous-contact segment analysed

reps.description: chair_stand_30s: completed sit-stand-sit cycles in 30 s

time_s.description: sit_to_stand_5x: seconds to the 5th standing; tug: Go to seated

speed_m_s.description: walking_speed: approximate metres per second (depends on the entered height and a side-on view)

quality.description: mobility tests: fraction of frames with visible legs

rep_times_s.description: chair_stand_30s: seconds from Go to each completed rep; sit_to_stand_5x: per-rep durations

freq_hz.description: hand_tremor: frequency (3-12 Hz) of the rhythmic hand movement

amp_pct.description: hand_tremor: RMS amplitude as % of hand size

p2p_pct.description: hand_tremor: peak-to-peak amplitude as % of hand size

blinks_per_min.description: blink: blinks per minute over the last minute of counted time

eyes_closed_pct.description: blink: share of the last minute the eyes were almost shut (PERCLOS, in %)

long_closures.description: blink: closures longer than a blink (over 0.5 s) in the last minute

active_min.description: activity: minutes moving while in view this session

still_min.description: activity: minutes in view and still

absent_min.description: activity: minutes with nobody in view

longest_still_min.description: activity: longest uninterrupted still stretch, minutes

count.description: snoring: snoring-sound events; pauses: possible pauses in breathing sounds

minutes.description: snoring / talking: total minutes of snoring sounds / talking time

per_hour.description: snoring: events per session hour; talking: minutes per session hour

rate_per_h.description: pauses: possible pauses per hour of regular breathing sounds; absent while under 30 minutes of it

regular_min.description: pauses: minutes of regular breathing sounds that count towards the rate

durations_s.description: pauses: duration of each possible pause, seconds

t.description: seconds since started_at when it was raised

kind.description: possible_fall, inactivity (check-in suggestions), cough, distress_sound (W10: a possible distress sound, label in trigger), possible_pause (W10: a possible pause in breathing sounds, t_onset..t_end)

trigger.description: possible_fall / inactivity: what triggered it; distress_sound: the sound label

merged_into_fall.description: distress_sound: this sound corroborated a possible fall and was shown as that fall’s check-in, not as its own (W10)

sound_cue.description: possible_fall: a thump / scream / glass sound was heard within 10 s (W10)
